Definition: Adna, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adna = "rest" or "pleasure"; 1) one of the family of Pahath-moab who returned with Ezra and married a foreign wife; 2) a priest, descendant of Harim in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
